definitions.inference_engine_time: Original-engine history start to terminal event, including loading/cache/decoding.
definitions.inference_engine_ram: Shared engine-host total minus free, sampled by the platform; not process RSS.
definitions.inference_engine_device: Engine total minus free; may include reclaimable allocator cache.
definitions.nvidia_memory: Sampled whole-card memory.used; includes desktop and other programs; may miss peaks.
definitions.training_time: Worker monotonic elapsed time including validation, import, preprocessing, training and saving.
definitions.training_allocator: Dedicated training-process PyTorch allocated/reserved high-water marks after reset.
definitions.training_ram: Sampled worker RSS and observed Windows peak working-set counter; not whole-host RAM.
definitions.unknown: Missing/invalid metrics stay null; no zero substitution or minimum-memory inference.
